title: Manhattan Buildings Through Time
summary: A 3D GeoLibre time animation of Manhattan's building stock, cumulatively replayed by construction year from 1850 to 2025 with MTA subway context.
question: How did Manhattan's present-day building stock accumulate over time, and how does that changing skyline read in 3D against the subway network?
interpretation: The Time Slider filters the current building-footprint dataset cumulatively by construction year. Building height is derived from the surveyed roof-height field; colors group buildings into broad construction eras.
limitations: This is a replay of the construction-year attribute in the current building-footprint dataset, not a historical reconstruction of demolished buildings.
Buildings with missing or zero construction year are excluded from the time animation.
The project uses live public NYC and MTA endpoints, so availability and field schemas can change.
The upstream GeoLibre showcase uses hosted vector tiles; this repository version intentionally uses authoritative public source endpoints to avoid committing expiring signed tile URLs.
